title: Induced disclosure through support ticket intake
problem_statement: Problematic data action: induced disclosure. Customers or agents may provide free-text details, photos, or other information disproportionate to the troubleshooting purpose in HelpDeskHQ. Potential problems: dignity loss, loss of autonomy, discrimination if sensitive details are included, and loss of trust.

title: Appropriation through post-termination retention
problem_statement: Problematic data action: appropriation. If HelpDeskHQ retains support records after termination or beyond a verified deletion window, data may continue to be held beyond Acme's authorization and beyond individual expectations. Potential problems: loss of trust, loss of autonomy, and economic loss if stale data is later exposed or reused.

title: Insecurity in US-hosted marketing processing
problem_statement: Problematic data action: insecurity. EU customer marketing and preference data sent to MarketReach in the United States may face insufficiently mitigated access or transfer exposure if SCCs, supplementary measures, or technical controls are incomplete. Potential problems: loss of trust, economic loss, discrimination, and dignity loss.

title: Appropriation through vendor reuse for analytics and benchmarking
problem_statement: Problematic data action: appropriation. Broad analytics or benchmarking language could let MarketReach use campaign data beyond Acme instructions and beyond what individuals reasonably expect in a processor relationship. Potential problems: loss of trust, loss of autonomy, and economic loss where individuals have no meaningful control over secondary use.

title: Appropriation through excessive marketing retention
problem_statement: Problematic data action: appropriation. Retaining inactive marketing profiles longer than Acme's 24 month rule extends storage and potential use beyond the expected purpose window. Potential problems: loss of trust, loss of autonomy, and economic loss through prolonged exposure over time.
